full_judgment: 33. Now we are to consider the so-called place of occurrence. It is stated by the investigating officer and other witnesses that this so-called place of occurrence is surrounded by the house of Bakul Miah, Anhui Amin Master, Bahar, Ayub, Moshiar, Azahar, Altaf, Taha Miah, Afsar, Shariful, Mojibor, Ansar and Saiful and there are shops nearby to the place of occurrence, but it is curious that nobody came to support the prosecution case or a responsible police officer did not take any measure to examine them? So it must be presumed that had they been brought to the court the real picture would have come before the court and as such adverse presumption should be drawn against prosecution under Section 114(g) of the Evidence Act that the prosecution has withheld the most important and vital witnesses to keep the court in dark about the real occurrence.
